generation_executor: render_candidates.py in this directory — parametric on es3083_artwork_geometry_substrate.json under the M7 construction rules (no hard-coded mm, SET_FACE only, live text, measured colours, no corner radius asserted). All curve geometry computed from scratch in-script; nothing traced from any web source.
c3_distinction: The shipped C3 lid (accepted §I) is untouched and its minimal-central layout is NOT re-served: A5, the quiet_minimal candidate, is composed as a lower-left ranged corner block inside a hairline patch keyline — no centred whisper stack, no centred rule.
first_render_defects_caught: Visual verification of the first contact sheet caught three composition defects before anything shipped: A1's spiral read as a square coil (rebuilt as an epitrochoid-on-spiral whose petal loops self-intersect); A3's Spanish line started INSIDE the giant B's measured 46mm advance — dark ink on dark glyph swallowed the leading S (column moved clear; assert_a3_column_clear now measures the B advance and refuses overlap); A4's leaves clustered into a knot (leaves now spaced along the stem tangent). assert_text_fits measures every tracked line against the frame. Guards are measurements, not eyeballing.

candidates.title: ROSE-GESTURE — one unbroken monoline rose, off-centre, cropped by the frame
candidates.originality_statement: Takes the harvested IDEA of a single continuous-line botanical mark drawn in one gesture (e03/e10), quiet single-gesture abstraction (e08), and the off-centre crop (e30). The curve itself is an original epitrochoid-on-spiral computed in render_candidates.py — no web line-drawing was traced, auto-vectorised, or imitated.

candidates.title: TWELVE-ROSETTE — six interleaved twelve-lobed rings; the module count echoes the palette's 12-pan interior
candidates.originality_statement: Takes the IDEAS of a centred radial botanical burst (e14), a mathematical rosette that reads as rose without depicting one (e22), and a module count echoing the product's own 12-pan grid (e04). The rings are r = R(0.91 + 0.09·cos12θ) with alternate-ring phase interleave, computed here — no pattern was copied.
